newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Site chosen for iron plant in Western Australia.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Site chosen for iron plant in Western Australia.

text.p: Western Australia's proposed A$1.4 billion Mid-West iron and steel project should be located at Oakajee, 25 km north of Geraldton, state Resources Development Minister Colin Barnett said on Tuesday.
This was subject to technical, economic, financial and environmental feasibility studies into the site and associated deep water port proving acceptable, he said in a statement.
Project proponents Kingstream Resources NL and Taiwan's An Feng Steel Co Ltd had indicated they were prepared to locate the site at Oakajee, provided a port was established nearby, he said.
The project was expected to bring A$17 million in royalties to the state government, he said.
The earliest a port would be in operation would be 2002, five years after the commencement of construction of the steel mill and two years after commencement of production, he said.
Planned annual capacity is 2.4 million tonnes.
